Brand teardowns

Weekly video teardown of a real brand, posted to LinkedIn and YouTube. Highest-engagement thing we make and the biggest driver into the Signal Test.

Learning

Signal Test paid, cold

Meta and YouTube against problem-aware audiences, optimised for test completion rather than clicks. Cost per completion is moving in the right direction; cost per booked call is not yet.

02

Running for clients

Named where the client is happy to be named, described generically where they are not.

Working

Oak Cliff Pilates — local acquisition

Geo-targeted paid plus member-generated content across three locations. Our own business, so it is also where we break things first.

Working

Van Country — seasonal demand

Search and retargeting against trip-type landing pages rather than the fleet page. Continues to outperform the old structure.

Learning

Nonprofit — event signups

Campaign refresh ahead of the annual event. Creative is testing well, the landing page is not converting at the rate the last one did. Being rebuilt this month.

Not working yet

B2B services — content engine

Long-form plus AEO structuring. Six weeks in, indexation is fine, citations in answer engines are not appearing. Either the structure is wrong or the timeline is longer than we assumed. We will say which by next month.

Why we publish the failures

Because an agency that has never shown you a campaign that did not work has either been extraordinarily lucky or is editing. The interesting question is not whether something failed — it is how quickly it got noticed and what happened next.
